item.title: 基础设施与算力：企业为速度抢购AI算力，却对成本一无所知
item.summary: Across 170 enterprises, AI infrastructure has moved decisively into production — two-thirds now run AI workloads live and three in 10 run them at scale — while the ability to account for what that infrastructure costs has not kept pace.
